meta.milestone: v1.4 特殊能量 12 张进人工池（10 套预设卡组的特殊能量不再是「解析链近似卡」）
meta.provenance: PRD §10 预设对手池 + P0 首批卡组复核清单 §2 核心构成（已核实卡名/构成要素）；卡面数值为引擎映射值（fidelity=approx），精确数值与完整 60 卡由 Limitless 收录 loader 覆盖（P1）
meta.i18n: name 为英文规范名（数据键，用于 Limitless 文本匹配）；name_zh 为**中文展示名**（前端/报告一律优先展示中文）；招式/特性的效果文本用 desc_zh（中文自述转写，**严禁逐字复制官方文案**），desc 为英文/旧字段兼容保留

attack_effects: dmg_plus:N:recoil:M (可选加伤 + 反伤联动，第四十七批)
dmg_set:N[:per:<counter>]（基础伤害按计数源重算，非加伤）
coin_per_target:N:scope:opp (每个对手宝可梦各抛一枚，正面才打它)
status_choose:<s1>+<s2>+<s3> (抛币后三选一，确定性取首个)
abilities: recon:N (field, 每回合一次)
cursed:N (hand, 弃此卡发动)
draw:N (field, 每回合一次)
move_damage:N|all (field, 每回合一次)
attach_energy:N[:type][:zone] (field, 每回合一次)
ko_draw:N (被动 · 被击倒时)
evolve_attach:N[:type][:zone] (被动 · 进化时)
weak_change:<type>[:<filter>] (被动 · 静态)
passive:bench_immune (被动 · 后备时免疫招式伤害与效果)
passive:bench_immune_dmg (被动 · 后备时只免疫招式伤害)
passive:dmg_immune:<self|team_bench>[:from:<src>|:min:<n>|:no_rule_box][:effects] (被动 · 静态免伤)
shield:prevent_all[:from:<src>|:if_damage:le:<n>][:effects] (下回合护盾；无 :effects 只挡伤害)
heal:all[:<scope>][:type:<c>] (回满；范围口径同 heal:N)
knockout:<opp_active|opp_bench|opp_any|opp_counters:N|both_active>[:basic] (招式直接击倒)
shuffle_top:N[:opp] (只重排顶部 N 张，不移动卡)
evolve_act:<tag1>|<tag2> (进化那一刻按序执行一次)
ko_prize_plus:N[:coin] (对手战斗位被击倒时多取奖赏，不叠加)
on_ko:counter:N (自身被击倒时反制攻击方)
on_ko:energy_to_hand:<type> (被击倒者身上的基础能量收回手牌)
on_ko:replay_evolve_act (战斗位被击倒时重放进化特性)
attach:N[:type][:zone][:target:bench] (附到后备)
stadium:bench_limit:8:require:tera[:trim:N] (后备上限 8)
stadium:no_bench_counters (后备不受对手效果指示物)
stadium:use:evolve_from_deck[:chain:1] (每回合一次检索进化，可链式)
:if_prev 后缀（in this way：仅当前序动作真的发生）
stadium:attack_plus:N:faction:<k> (场地加伤，弱点/抗性之前)
stadium:no_retreat:faction:<k> (场地：阵营宝可梦无撤退费用)
stadium:no_tool_effect (场地：道具失效)
stadium:status_immune:require:energy (场地：附着能量者免疫特殊状态)
stadium:evolve_same_turn:type:<c> (场地：上场当回合可进化)
stadium:dmg_immune:box:none:from:rulebox (场地：无规则框目标免疫规则框来源)
search_pokemon|trainer|any|energy:N (全牌库检索；与 recon 语义不同)
coin:heads:<tag> (特性侧抛一次后执行子效果，Dustox)
passive:coin_prevent:<color> (被招式伤害时抛币免伤，Fezandipiti)
counters:<n>[:per:<c>][:scope:opp[:<count>]|:scope:self] (指示物直放；含己方战斗位)
trainers: coin_flip:heads:<a>[|tails:<b>] (同一枚币的双分支，只抛一次)
shuffle_both_coin_draw:<mine_h>:<opp_h>:<mine_t>:<opp_t> (双方洗回手牌 + 抛币分抽)
team_shield:reduce:<n>:type:<color> (对手下回合全队限时减伤，含新上场者)
shield_choose:prevent_all[:from:<src>][:effects][:gate:<cond>] (单体限时护盾 + 打出前置条件)
conditions: opp_prizes_le:<n> (对手剩余奖赏 ≤ n；打出前置条件用)

meta.ip_note: 仅收录卡名与规则数值，不含官方图像/插画（C2）；数据与代码分离，再分发红线见 PRD C1/C5
meta.k2_note: desc_zh 同时作为 K2「卡牌效果解析」语料：由 agent.effects 解析为结构化 spec 并映射到引擎 tag；无法映射的部分在解析报告中显式列出（诚实标注）
meta.special_energy_note: 12 张特殊能量从扩展池**升格**为人工条目（2026-11-10）：引擎侧 `special_energy.py` 对每个 kind 的 provides / 条件 / 附加规则逐字段建模，本文件只是把它们登记为「已人工校对」，使 `reallib.coverage()` 的 approximated 归零（INV-A 要求预设卡组零占位零近似）。tag 与印刷 uid 必须与扩展池逐字一致，否则卡表按 uid 找不到卡。

cards.name: Boomerang Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If this card is discarded by an effect of an attack used by the Pokémon this card is attached to, attach this card from your discard pile to that Pokémon after attacking.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡因附着此卡的宝可梦所使用招式的效果而被弃置，则在攻击后从弃牌堆将此卡附着于该宝可梦。

cards.name: Neo Upper Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If this card is attached to a Stage 2 Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 2 Energy at a time.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡附着于 2 阶进化宝可梦，则此卡提供所有属性的能量，但一次只提供 2 个能量。

cards.name: Mist Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent’s Pokémon done to the Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

防止对手的宝可梦所使用招式对此卡附着的宝可梦造成的所有效果。（已有的效果不会被移除。伤害不是效果。）

cards.name: Legacy Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. This effect of your Legacy Energy only works once per game.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供所有属性的能量，但一次只提供 1 个能量。

若此卡附着的宝可梦因对手的宝可梦所用招式的伤害而被击倒，则该玩家少拿 1 张奖赏卡。你的「遗产能量」的这个效果每局只能生效 1 次。

cards.name: Enriching Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

When you attach this card from your hand to a Pokémon, draw 4 cards.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

当你从手牌将此卡附着于宝可梦时，抽 4 张牌。

cards.name: Spiky Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡附着的宝可梦位于战斗区，且受到对手的宝可梦所用招式的伤害（即使此宝可梦被击倒），则在攻击的宝可梦上放置 2 个伤害指示物。

cards.name: Team Rocket's Energy
cards.desc:
This card can only be attached to a Team Rocket’s Pokémon. If this card is attached to anything other than a Team Rocket’s Pokémon, discard this card.

As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides 2 in any combination of {P} Energy and {D} Energy.
cards.desc_zh:
此卡只能附着于火箭队的宝可梦。若此卡附着于火箭队的宝可梦以外的对象，则弃置此卡。

只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 2 个能量，其属性为 {P} 能量与 {D} 能量的任意组合。

cards.name: Prism Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If this card is attached to a Basic Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡附着于基础宝可梦，则此卡提供所有属性的能量，但一次只提供 1 个能量。

cards.name: Ignition Energy
cards.desc:
If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn.

As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {C} Energy.

If this card is attached to an Evolution Pokémon, it provides {C}{C}{C} Energy instead.
cards.desc_zh:
若此卡附着于你的 1 只宝可梦，则在你回合结束时弃置此卡。

只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {C} 能量。

若此卡附着于进化宝可梦，则改为提供 {C}{C}{C} 能量。

cards.name: Grow Grass Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {G} Energy.
The {G} Pokémon this card is attached to gets +20 HP.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {G} 能量。
此卡附着的 {G} 宝可梦的 HP +20。

cards.name: Telepath Psychic Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {P} Energy.
When you attach this card from your hand to a {P} Pokémon, search your deck for up to 2 Basic {P} Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {P} 能量。
当你从手牌将此卡附着于 {P} 宝可梦时，从牌库中检索至多 2 只基础 {P} 宝可梦并放置于后备。然后洗牌。

cards.name: Rock Fighting Energy
cards.desc:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {F} Energy.
Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent’s Pokémon done to the {F} Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)
cards.desc_zh:
只要此卡附着于宝可梦，就提供 {F} 能量。
防止对手的宝可梦所使用招式对此卡附着的 {F} 宝可梦造成的所有效果。（已有的效果不会被移除。伤害不是效果。）
